question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dune, Bob gets Ivanhoe, Claire gets Beloved, Dave gets The Hobbit, Eve gets Walden, Fred gets Dracula, and Gertrude gets Hamlet.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Eve and Alice swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Then, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap books. Finally, Dave and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Eve has
Options:
(A) Dune
(B) Ivanhoe
(C) Beloved
(D) The Hobbit
(E) Walden
(F) Dracula
(G) Hamlet
solution:
Each row lists books in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: Dune, Ivanhoe, Beloved, The Hobbit, Walden, Dracula, Hamlet.
After Eve–Alice: Walden, Ivanhoe, Beloved, The Hobbit, Dune, Dracula, Hamlet.
After Alice–Bob: Ivanhoe, Walden, Beloved, The Hobbit, Dune, Dracula, Hamlet.
After Gertrude–Eve: Ivanhoe, Walden, Beloved, The Hobbit, Hamlet, Dracula, Dune.
After Claire–Eve: Ivanhoe, Walden, Hamlet, The Hobbit, Beloved, Dracula, Dune.
After Dave–Eve: Ivanhoe, Walden, Hamlet, Beloved, The Hobbit, Dracula, Dune.
After Bob–Gertrude: Ivanhoe, Dune, Hamlet, Beloved, The Hobbit, Dracula, Walden.
After Dave–Alice: Beloved, Dune, Hamlet, Ivanhoe, The Hobbit, Dracula, Walden.
Eve has The Hobbit, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
